item.title: Netorare Sankaku Kankei ~Hatsukoi no Osananajimi ga Sefure ni Sareta~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: TRYSET Break, Position Co., Ltd.
  • 発売日: 2020-08-28
  • スコア: 6.24/10 (36 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 寝取られ三角関係 ～初恋の幼なじみがセフレにされた～
  • 英語名: Netorare Sankaku Kankei Hatsukoi no Osananajimi ga Sefure ni Sareta

あらすじ

The story centers around Sakagami Daichi, a salaryman at an insurance company, who has feelings for his childhood friend and first love, Matsuura Sakuya. However, Sakuya doesn’t reciprocate these feelings. Daichi often spends weekends drinking with his friend Hori Ryouma, a sports club instructor. One day, Daichi wakes up to discover that Sakuya and Ryouma are in a romantic relationship, leading to a twist in their close friendship.
